nt2e61.title: In This House: Cancer's rules
nt2e61.caption: Cancer will send you home with five tubs of soup and then text "home safe" from the mailbox. Twelve steps. Which rule does your house have?

nt2e62.title: In This House: an Aries and Virgo home
nt2e62.caption: Aries wins every race to the door, then holds it open anyway. Virgo labels the chaos. And every fight starts with snacks. Who in your house runs the label maker?

nt2e63.title: In This House: Aquarius rules
nt2e63.caption: The robot arm hands you the remote, Thursday is rock collection night, and "I love you" no longer comes in binary. What's the weirdest rule you'd keep?

nt2e64.title: In This House: Capricorn's calendar
nt2e64.caption: Every square of the week is planned except one, circled twice: NOTHING. Capricorn in striped socks, resting on purpose. Tag the friend who needs that square.

nt2e65.title: In This House: Libra says no
nt2e65.caption: Teal or plum? They talked it out. The chipped mug is the favourite. And a fourth weekend plan got a kind, clear "not this time." Proud of you, Libra.

nt2e66.title: Plot Twist: the late date
nt2e66.caption: Twenty minutes late, three drafts deleted, one map with three pins. Meanwhile they were outside the door practising hello. Which sign rehearses their entrance?
